name: Twynix HMI Studio
purpose: Author, preview and publish industrial HMI screens with ThingsBoard telemetry, bounded JavaScript behaviors and guarded runtime actions.

smoke_test.instructions: With the pinned Node and locked dependencies installed, run npm run build and npm run test:smoke. The isolated browser suite serves the production editor at loopback port 4300, uses synthetic API/telemetry fixtures, and exercises editing, Preview, published Runtime, script recovery and connected port geometry. See docs/engineering/quality-gates.md.
smoke_test.evidence: 2026-11-16 service extraction: 22 Chromium smoke tests passed; 171 Node tests and two isolated browser performance checks passed. Recorded in docs/architecture/editor-runtime.md. This historical evidence is not a claim of a clean export, remote CI, or production readiness; template-adoption checks are recorded in docs/setup.md.
